author: sleepinyourhat
text:
🚨New dataset for LLM/scalable oversight evaluations! 🚨

This has been one of the big central efforts of my NYU lab over the last year, and I’m really exited to start using it.

quoted.text:
🧵Announcing GPQA, a graduate-level “Google-proof” Q&A benchmark designed for scalable oversight! w/ @_julianmichael_, @sleepinyourhat

GPQA is a dataset of *really hard* questions that PhDs with full access to Google can’t answer.

Paper: https://t.co/hb4u4xX1uY https://t.co/YCdpP4yPBu

author: sleepinyourhat
text: Neat short-term AI safety research position working with some of my collaborators at NYU! I'd recommend it!

quoted.text:
Want to work on methods for evaluating and supervising GPT-n, as n -> ∞? 

A subset of the Alignment Research Group @ NYU (me, @idavidrein, @_julianmichael_, @ihsgnef) are looking for scholars to mentor via MATS!

author: sleepinyourhat
text: I’m sharing a draft of a slightly-opinionated survey paper I’ve been working on for the last couple of months. It's meant for a broad audience—not just LLM researchers. (🧵) https://t.co/sukGTb9cZC

text: “There is no more profound human bias than the expectation Tomorrow probably will be like today... But cast your gaze 10 or 20 years out. Typically, that has been possible in human history. I don’t think it is now.”
